name: What should I do to prepare my home for cabinet installation?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare my home for cabinet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for cabinet installation, ensure the work area is clear of all personal belongings, small appliances, and furniture. If existing cabinets are being removed, clear out their contents beforehand. It's also helpful to protect nearby floors and surfaces with drop cloths or plastic sheeting. If any plumbing or electrical work is required before installation, ensure that it is completed. We will provide specific instructions tailored to your project during our planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the work area of belongings, protect nearby surfaces, and complete any necessary plumbing or electrical work beforehand.
